description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {U}.
Repeat.
